_comment: Model tiers for the dispatcher agent. CONFIG, NOT CODE: swapping a model is a settings change plus a container restart, never an edit to the calling code.

Part 1 deliberately runs ONE model behind the whole interface: every tier resolves through `activeTier` below, pinned to `standard`. The per-tier ids are declared so the routing seam exists and the swap is a one-line change, but real tier routing is Part 10 — it needs usage data, and routing chosen before that data exists is guesswork.

`id` is the Bedrock inference-profile id actually invoked. Use eu.* only: global.* profiles route outside the EU. Any id can be overridden per tier with BEDROCK_MODEL_<TIER> (e.g. BEDROCK_MODEL_STANDARD).

Availability (verified 2026-09-23, account 039066033404, eu-north-1): Opus 5 / Sonnet 5 / Opus 4.8 / 4.7 are account-gated by AWS. `id` names the model this build TARGETS; `fallbackId` is proven to work in this account today and is used when the primary is unavailable.

standard.purpose: The default for everything in Part 1.

extraction.purpose: Vision: reading AIP PDF pages and charts.

rerank.purpose: Not available in eu-north-1; see docs/aws-bedrock-setup.md.
